root_admission.decision_basis: Recover failed cached GUI with unchanged physical fields and regression tolerance. First audit exact frozen producer-function AST/source bytes; then record actual producer/canonical/legacy ECDF values, denominators, thresholds, errors and boundary gaps BEFORE regression. Reproduce saved producer statistics using their published definitions and present one common canonical volumeCDF for crossgeometry display while preserving original statistics/electrical/matching scales separately. Do not presume empirical cause or force a pass; all original source/fields/failure evidence preserved. Actual single-pair2RHS remain those in published afceb318c4501bb975b91915fdd3388f55709dab; no new PDE/Q/angular; root reviewed source-only audits positively.
